disclaimer: Context + risk posture — an AI risk-officer reading of the engine's own deterministic outputs, not a forecast and not stock selection. Treat as odds.
risk_read: The engine's risk_state is neutral at 24/100, but the underlying evidence shows a more fragile tape than that score implies. The MTF monitor has 8 breakdowns including IWM, TLT, XLY, XLC, XLRE, and XLU [E3] — that is a broad, defensive rotation disguised by a still-firm large-cap index. Credit is widening [E2] and complacency is on watch [E1][E2]. Dealer gamma is long but spot sits very close to the flip (7691.76 vs 7672.07) and the vol-hole is IN_HOLE, meaning dealer hedging can quickly flip from dampening to amplifying moves [E4]. The thematic leader (Memory/HBM) carries negative impulse and negative breadth with high crowding [E5], and the prophet buy board is gated off (gate_go=False) [E7], which signals the engine itself is not allowing fresh entries. Put together, this looks like a late-stage, narrowing tape with hidden internal deterioration — drawdown risk is building beneath a calm surface.
